title: Application, Accounts, and Database

learning_objectives: Explain main_app, database manager, and UI workflow in plain language and connect it to source/main_app.py; source/database_manager.py; source/user_authentication_v1.py.
Trace one input through the application, accounts, and database stage and identify its output and assumptions.
Diagnose one failure mode or limitation before extending this stage.
prerequisites: Read project prerequisites and the previous module when present.
concepts_covered: main_app, database manager, and UI workflow
practical_outcomes: Trace the application, accounts, and database stage through the cited source paths.
Produce a small test or diagnostic for main_app, database manager, and UI workflow.
completion_criteria: Complete the three lessons and exercise.
Answer all ten module questions using material from these lessons.
Submit a short source citation and limitation note.
